title: Handmade Italian Pasta at Egro
subtitle: A Hands-On Journey into the Heart of Pugliese Pasta
description: Join us for an intimate, hands-on pasta-making class in the heart of London. Learn the time-honoured art of Pugliese pasta — no eggs, no machines, just semolina flour, water, and your hands. I'll guide you through every step, from mixing and kneading the dough to shaping beautiful orecchiette and cavatelli, just as generations of Southern Italian families have done before us.
longDescription: There is something deeply satisfying about making pasta from scratch. In this workshop you'll discover why Pugliese pasta — made with only semolina and water — has a texture and soul that no shop-bought substitute can match.

Set in the warm and welcoming surroundings of Egro Coffee in Angel Islington, this class is designed to be enjoyable for complete beginners and confident cooks alike. You'll leave with a new skill, a full stomach, and a recipe to recreate the magic at home.
whatYouCreate: Handmade water-based pasta dough from scratch
Traditional shapes: orecchiette, cavatelli, and more
A fresh seasonal sauce to go with your pasta
skills: Mixing and kneading semolina dough to the right consistency
Cooking, plating, and storing fresh pasta
included: QR code with the full recipe to take home
Expert guidance in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere
closingNote: We'll finish by sitting down together to enjoy the pasta you've made. Buon appetito!
